confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of London price levels for the July 2026 peak season; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are better established; hostel and hotel figures are least certain given wide variation by district, lead time and demand. USD values rely on an approximate GBP-to-USD conversion. Cocktail and wine anchors reflect direct knowledge of London bar prices, sanity-checked against the beer anchor. Beer assumes a pint-scale draft serving, the inexpensive meal assumes no alcohol, and accommodation assumes VAT-inclusive rates with no visitor levy. FX figure comes from search summaries of RBA pages that reported the same 15 October value; the pages were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable city is needed; estimates rest on direct knowledge of London, benchmarked against other high-cost Western European capitals such as Paris and Amsterdam, with London placed at the upper end for July accommodation.
